verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਰਹੈ ਇਕ ਟੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhukheeaa dhusaT dhubaajaraa bagul samaadh rahai ik Ta(n)gaa|

en.bdb: An evil and dual-minded person suffers like the crane standing on one leg.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਜਰ ਪਾਪ ਨ ਉਤਰਨਿ ਘੁਟਿ ਘੁਟਿ ਜੀਆਂ ਖਾਇ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: bajar paap na utaran ghuT ghuT jeeaa(n) khai vich ga(n)gaa|

en.bdb: Standing in Ganges, it strangulates creatures to eat them and its sins are never washed out.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਵੈ ਤੂੰਬੜੀ ਤਰਿ ਤਰਿ ਤਨੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਕਰਿ ਨੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: teerath naavai too(n)baRee tar tar tan dhovai kar na(n)gaa|

en.bdb: Colocynth may swim naked and bath at one pilgrimage centre after another,

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਕਾਲਕੂਟੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਕਰਮੁ ਕੁਢੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: man vich vasai kaalakooT bharam na utarai karam kudda(n)gaa|

en.bdb: But its action are so crooked that the poison in its heart never goes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਰਮੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ ਬੈਠਾ ਜਾਇ ਪਤਾਲਿ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: varamee maaree naa marai baiThaa jai pataal bhuia(n)gaa|

en.bdb: Beating the hole of a snake does not kill it, for it remains (safe)  in the nether world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਸਤੀ ਨੀਰਿ ਨਵਾਲੀਐ ਨਿਕਲਿ ਖੇਹ ਉਡਾਏ ਅੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: hasatee neer navaaleeaai nikal kheh uddaae a(n)gaa|

en.bdb: The elephant coming out of water after a bath, again blows dust around its limbs.
The sense of duality is not at all a good sense.
